task: Decide whether a website is a phishing site.
instructions: You are helping a feature-selection search for a classification task. Rate how useful each feature is likely to be for predicting the class, on its own or together with a few others, from 0 (useless) to 1 (most useful). Use only your knowledge of the domain and the descriptions given; you do not see the data. Reply with a JSON object only: {"scores": {"<feature index>": <score>, ...}} with one entry for every feature index listed.

calls.reply:
```json
{
  "scores": {
    "0": 0.9,  // Likely URL-based features (e.g., presence of suspicious subdomains, misspellings, or non-standard TLDs)
    "1": 0.85, // Likely domain age or registration details (older domains are often more legitimate)
    "2": 0.9,  // Likely presence of HTTPS (secure connection) or HTTP (insecure)
    "3": 0.8,  // Likely page load time or server response time (phishing sites often have slower responses)
    "4": 0.75, // Likely presence of suspicious links or redirects (e.g., "paypal-security-login.com")
    "5": 0.85, // Likely presence of fake login forms (e.g., "Sign In" pages mimicking banks)
    "6": 0.7,  // Likely presence of pop-ups or alerts (common in phishing)
    "7": 0.8,  // Likely presence of suspicious keywords in the URL (e.g., "update," "verify," "account")
    "8": 0.6,  // Likely page content analysis (e.g., grammar/spelling errors, urgency in language)
    "9": 0.75, // Likely presence of fake certificates or security badges
    "10": 0.8, // Likely presence of suspicious IP addresses or hosting (e.g., free web hosts like 000webhost)
    "11": 0.65, // Likely presence of social media sharing buttons (often missing in phishing)
    "12": 0.7,  // Likely presence of suspicious JavaScript or obfuscated code
    "13": 0.5,  // Likely page metadata (e.g., title, description) analysis (may be misleading)
    "14": 0.6,  // Likely presence of fake contact information (e.g., fake phone/email)
    "15": 0.7,  // Likely presence of suspicious images (e.g., blurred logos, fake seals)
    "16": 0.55, // Likely presence of unusual URL parameters (e.g., "?id=123&action=login")
    "17": 0.6,  // Likely presence of suspicious third-party scripts (e.g., trackers, malware)
    "18": 0.4,  // Likely page structure (e.g., depth, navigation) — less discriminative
    "19": 0.5,  // Likely presence of fake reviews or testimonials
    "20": 0.65, // Likely presence of suspicious email headers (if applicable)

  }
```
